transcript: Whatever you do, do not drink coffee on an empty stomach. Most people wake up tired, stressed, and already running from the day. So before they give the body water, before they give the body food, before they even give the mind one peaceful breath, they pour black fire into an empty stomach and call it energy. But that is not energy. That is borrowing from tomorrow. Coffee on an empty stomach can make your body feel like it is being chased. Your heart beats faster. Your stomach feels sharp. Your mind becomes anxious. And then by afternoon, you crash and wonder why you feel weak, irritated, and hungry for sugar. The problem is not always the coffee. The problem is the timing. You are waking up a tired body and whipping it like an old horse. Do not do this. First, give the body water. Then give it something gentle. A little real food. Or even fiber in your morning drink. So the stomach is not empty and the body starts steady. The fiber I recommend is physicians choice. It mixes smoothly into water, tea, or coffee, and helps support digestion before the day begins. You can find it on Amazon or through the link in my profile. Coffee should be a tool, not the master of your morning. Follow for more old monk health lessons.
